extraction.Name: William Allen
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged for $200 then sold the land for $600
extraction.Buyer: sold to settle debts and mortgage to C. E. Vandervoor, Sr.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: It was sold to settle debts and mortgage to C. E. Vandervoor, Sr.; The allottee feels that he was defrauded of his land, by demand for settlement of old debts.
extraction.NOTES: Date and manner of delivery of patent: 1-24-1918, by mail. No property or money accumulated. No inherited land. Wife and two children dependent upon him. Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes: no. Mortgage not released or foreclosed. Witnesses both of Pawnee, Okla. Notary commission expires Jan. 31, 1929. Document dated November 26, 1928.
